LibreOffice._comment: Path to LibreOffice soffice.exe — used to snapshot Office files (Word/Excel) inline in the OCV report. Optional: if omitted, the app auto-detects the default install path. Install LibreOffice on each machine (local + server) that generates the report.

Brand._comment: ROW instance brand (Services/Brand.cs). Same keys as the NestJS edition. Deployment values: set per server, e.g. Brand__Domains__AdminOrigin, Brand__Support__Phones__0.

Scope._comment: District 5656 = our own test district (Zone 0, Rotary Club of Thane City View). Exempt: never terminated, never cascaded to non-sync, members may log in.

LoginAllowlist._comment: DISABLED post-go-live. Was a temporary gate during initial verification. Re-enable (Enabled=true) only if you need to lock the site down again. Mobile app login is never gated by this list.

MembershipDuesReconciliation._comment: Safety net for lost Cashfree webhooks on membership dues. Every IntervalMinutes it re-checks membership_dues_payments rows still PaymentStatus='ACTIVE'/IsPaid=0 that are older than MinAgeMinutes and newer than LookbackDays, by calling Cashfree GET /pg/orders/{merchant order_id} (+ /payments). A row is marked paid ONLY when Cashfree reports order_status=PAID AND a payment with payment_status=SUCCESS — 'ACTIVE' is also the resting state of an abandoned checkout, so nothing is ever inferred from age or amount. Marked rows get PaidSource='Reconciled'. Enabled=false by default: turn on deliberately.

Razorpay._comment: Wallet credit top-up. Provide LIVE KeyId/KeySecret/WebhookSecret at deploy (KeyId is the only value returned to the browser). Pricing rates are in paise; GstPercent is added ON TOP of the base amount; credits derive from the base amount only. Keys left as PLACEHOLDER make signature verification no-op so nothing is credited against an unprovisioned gateway.

ClubWebsitePricingApproval._comment: OTP approver for editing the system-wide DEFAULT club-website prices (settings/wallet). OTP goes to this fixed email (and OtpMobile if set). Change OtpEmail to the boss's email after go-live.

Gemini._comment: Google Gemini (free tier) for AI project-classification suggestions. Get a free API key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey and paste it below. Leave the PLACEHOLDER value to disable AI suggestions.

Firebase._comment: ServiceAccountPath is relative to ContentRoot. Place firebase-admin.json in App_Data/ (not committed to git).

CitationAutoPoints._comment: DailyLoopEnabled: when true, the API runs the full district-wide citation auto-points recalc 30 seconds after startup and every 24 hours after. Default false — the nightly recalc is owned by the standalone AwardsAutoCalcWorker console (Task Scheduler 02:30 AM). The live recalc trigger (ICitationRecalcTrigger, fired from write-side services after a citation-relevant save) is INDEPENDENT of this flag and always works.

DailyStatsReport._comment: Daily statistics email (counts in the body + a multi-sheet Excel: Sync Clubs, Non-Sync Clubs, District-wise summary). Fires once a day at Hour:00 in the brand time zone (Brand:Locale:DefaultTimeZone). Enabled defaults true; the service itself never mails from a dev machine (non-localhost DB) so this can stay on everywhere. Recipients defaults to the two addresses below when omitted.

PleskSettings._serverIpComment: ServerIp intentionally omitted: PleskService falls back to BaseUrl's host when unset, so the DNS-pointing check always tracks BaseUrl. Only set ServerIp explicitly if the Plesk panel and the public-facing IP customers point domains at are ever different boxes.
